title: people-ops-manager-prep-q1-2026
content:
Notes to self for upcoming manager 1:1 + Q1 planning. Rough, keep editing.

Purpose:
- Prep talking points for my manager 1:1 and Q1 calibration. Want to be concise: wins, blockers, asks.
- Align on career trajectory, bandwidth, and priority tradeoffs (hiring vs programs).

Top wins (last 3 months):
- Onboarding revamp: reduced time-to-offer onboarding kit + playbook. Pilot with 3 new hires; survey NPS +0.6 vs old flow.
- Benefits enrollment project: coordinated with finance to roll out new parental leave policy; completed comms + FAQ packet.
- OKR support: created template and runbook so PMs + Eng leads can publish measurable people metrics. Saved ~6 hours/wk of PM time during planning.
- Escalation handling: de-escalated two complex manager/individual contributor cases with HR counsel, outcome documented.

Concrete examples to share in 1:1:
- Onboarding: before/after timeline + one quote from new hire. Metric: mean ramp time (first PR merged) dropped from 28 -> 20 days in pilot.
- Benefits: stakeholder map + brief timeline (legal -> finance -> benefits vendor -> comms). Note risk we still have around-dependent contractors excluded from new policy.

Goals for Q1 2026 (draft):
1) Launch onboarding v1.1 across all teams (goal: 95% completion within 2 weeks of start).
2) Build manager enablement program (monthly office hours + 1-day manager training).
3) Reduce time-to-hire for IC roles by 15% through screening changes + hiring scorecard.
4) Pilot career ladder calibration with Eng and Product (2 teams).

Metrics I will track:
- Onboarding completion %, ramp (first PR), new hire satisfaction survey score
- Time-to-fill by role category, offer acceptance rate
- Manager enablement attendance + survey NPS

Blockers / Risks to raise:
- Bandwidth: current hiring for People Ops specialist delayed; need decision on contractor vs FTE by Feb 1.
- Engineering capacity: request for internal tooling to auto-provision onboarding accounts pushed to backlog - ask for prioritized slot or temporary vendor support.
- Legal review queue for international benefits changes - could delay rollout into EU/APAC.

Asks of manager (specific):
- Approve headcount for People Ops specialist (linked business case) or greenlight 3-month contractor budget.
- Help prioritize tickets with infra/product to get onboarding provisioning automated (1 sprint).
- Advocate in exec sync for cross-functional time for career ladder pilot (need Eng + Prod leads + 4 managers).

Career / growth conversation items:
- Intend to take on more strategy: owning People Ops roadmap and representation in GTM planning.
- Ask for mentorship on stakeholder influence (exec-level comms).
- Seek timeline for next step (Sr. Manager) and what concrete deliverables to show in next 6-9 months.

Feedback I want from manager:
- Where should I focus limited energy: scaling programs vs hiring/building team?
- Assessment of my leadership visibility across company (examples to illustrate).
- Feedback on presentation style for exec updates (what to tighten).

1:1 agenda (10-15 min):
- Quick status (wins + one risk) - 3 minutes
- Headcount decision (ask) - 3 minutes
- Prioritization ask for infra ticket - 3 minutes
- Career discussion + next steps - remaining time

Open questions / notes to fix before sending:
- Pull the onboarding pilot survey raw data and include 2 slides with distribution by team. (action: generate chart before 1:1).
- Draft concise headcount justification (ROI paragraph + cost estimate).
- Draft a 1-page summary of manager enablement program to share with Lena & Aisha.

Tone reminders: keep it short, evidence-backed, and concrete. Avoid long narrative in 1:1 - leave follow-up materials in Confluence link.

-- quick TODOs (editable):
- [ ] Run onboarding metric query (dataset: HR-analytics) - due 2026-01-07
- [ ] Finalize contractor vs FTE pros/cons doc - due 2026-01-08
- [ ] Share draft manager enablement one-pager with Lena & Aisha - due 2026-01-09

Random thoughts (scratchpad):
- Could we pair with Developer Experience for the onboarding automation? They care about dev environment UX.
- Consider cohort-based onboarding (groups every 2 weeks) if volume increases.

End of notes.

(Will iterate and move final summary to Confluence once reviewed.)
